title: RC Inference & Author Agreement Question Strategy

notes.html:
RC Inference & Author Agreement Question Examples

  • The passage suggests that the author would be most likely to agree with which one of the following statements about the contemporary critics of Einstein's studies of radioactivity?

  • Suppose a corporation is convicted of a crime having a detection ratio of 1-in-10. Based on the passage, the author would be most likely to endorse which one of the following penalities?

  • Given the information in the passage, which one of the following hypothetical events is LEAST likely to occur?

    • This is an Inference EXCEPT question.

  • The author ascribes which one of the following views to the economists discussed in the passage?

  • Based on the passage, Ellison's critics would most likely have responded favorably to Invisible Man if it had
